summary.text: Ed Orcutt is a Republican member of the Washington House of Representatives, representing District 20-Position 2 since 2003, and is on the ballot for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He works as a forestry consultant.

paragraphs.text: Orcutt earned an A.S. in forestry from the University of Maine and a B.S. in forestry management from the University of Idaho.

He worked as a resource aide, firefighter and timber manager for the Idaho Department of Lands from 1985 to 1989, in timber inventory for Northwest Management from 1989 to 1990, and has been a forestry consultant for Niemi Forestry since 1990.
Ballotpedia's campaign finance records list Orcutt's winning races for the House from 2002 through 2010 in District 18 and from 2012 in District 20.
During the 2023-2024 session he was assigned to the Rural Development, Agriculture, and Natural Resources Committee, the Finance Committee and the House Transportation Committee.
He served as ranking minority member of the Finance Committee in the 2019-2020 and 2021-2022 sessions.
